receipt.public_excerpt: AI use is now almost universal.

evidence_items.explanation: The survey of 1,054 full-time UK undergraduates reports 94% using generative AI to help with assessed work. This supports continued use in that population, without establishing a shift to open source.

Students most commonly named these services when asked which tools their institutions provided. This complicates a simple affordability-to-open-source account, but institutional provision does not measure students' migration or establish licensing choices.

unresolved_gaps: No representative longitudinal evidence establishes an affordability-driven migration to open source.
Institutional provision is not equivalent to students' product preferences.
UK evidence does not establish a worldwide undergraduate pattern.
